_doc: Round 10 violin per-note table (size 1): gain_db = dB on each partial's output gain (index 0 = the fundamental); dark_db = dB added to each partial's onset darkening (decaying as exp(-t/ob_s), negative brightens; 48 partials, the last held above); the scalars replace the global for that note (round 10 adds hiss_db, dB on the hiss, and a0_db, the air mode's level). Read at note-on by the nearest MIDI note; none outside first..last. Round 11: rs0_db, rs1_db, rs2_db (45 each): the residual layers' spectra, dB of band energy in look.py's 1/6-octave bands (80 Hz-16 kHz, the 45 with STFT bins) as the score's STFT (2048 Hann) reads them, at an envelope of 1, in the twin's output units (-200 = off): rs0 the sustain's noise, rs1 the onset's, rs2 the release's.
